name: Noble Dental Clinical Outcomes Dataset (2025 Edition)
description: Open dataset summarizing clinical performance, patient satisfaction, and treatment success rates across preventive, restorative, and advanced dentistry cases at Noble Dental Care, Nallagandla, Hyderabad.

variableMeasured.name: Root Canal Treatment Success Rate
variableMeasured.description: Percentage of root canal cases achieving radiographic and symptomatic success after 6 months.

variableMeasured.name: Average Patient Satisfaction Score
variableMeasured.description: Aggregate patient feedback score from verified Google and in-clinic surveys.

variableMeasured.name: Average Appointment Duration
variableMeasured.description: Mean chair time across all treatments recorded in 2024–2025 window.

variableMeasured.name: Postoperative Complication Rate
variableMeasured.description: Incidence of postoperative sensitivity or inflammation beyond 48 hours.

variableMeasured.name: Child Cooperation Rate (Pediatric Cases)
variableMeasured.description: Percentage of children completing full procedures without sedation or rescheduling.

citation: Dhivakaran R, Ronaldo R. Noble Dental Clinical Outcomes Dataset 2025. NDC-D Research Cell, Hyderabad.
